BiblicalUsage: Zemar is instrumental music, the sound of the instruments themselves, and it appears only in Daniel 3, at Nebuchadnezzar's golden image. Every time the music sounds, cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, and psaltery, all the peoples are commanded to fall down and worship the image, and Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refuse.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe music is a gift that can be bent to idolatry, and the test is not the sound but the one it tells us to bow to.
RelatedPeople: Daniel; King Nebuchadnezzar; Shadrach; Meshach; Abednego
